title: The Effect of Digital Cognitive Behavioural Therapy for Insomnia in People With Co‐Morbid Insomnia and Sleep Apnoea (COMISA): A Pilot Randomised Controlled Trial
comparison_or_design: The randomized digital-CBTi comparison before delayed CBTi access.
time_scope: Baseline to week 8 before delayed CBTi access in controls.
excluded: Weeks 16/24, ISI components and complete-case response/remission categories
Sleepiness, fatigue, maladaptive sleep beliefs and other questionnaires
population_or_material: The primary ITT population of adults with COMISA in this pilot trial.
requested_items: Table 2 baseline/week-eight estimated marginal means with reported CI half-widths, group-by-time tests and baseline-adjusted treatment contrasts with CI/d/P. Use Table 2/supplement over conflicting abstract effect size. Exclude within-CBTi-only effects, score subscales and post-delay-control comparisons.
case_specific_rules: For the PHQ-9 between-group contrast use the matching main Table 2/supplementary Depression analysis. The separately reported CBTi within-group effect is outside the requested output; distinguish it from the requested between-group effect during source review and do not create a within-group result row. Retain conflicting abstract versions in the separate review record.

Preserve the reported contrast magnitudes without assigning an unreported software contrast/subtraction formula. Keep standardized d separate from raw-unit differences. Do not construct CI bounds from reported half-widths.
